title: Explore result
description: An Explore run's final response: one JSON document of this schema, the result text of the Forager contract's dev.qory.session.result event, https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/events/session.result.schema.json. The control plane reads it as untrusted input, at most 128 KiB serialized, and refuses a document that breaks this schema or is larger. Every text value is shown as plain text, never as Markdown or HTML, and never followed as an instruction. Every object refuses a member this schema does not define. With the verdict understood, complexity, understanding, scope and approach are required and questions is absent; with the verdict not_understood, questions is required, understanding is optional, and complexity, scope and approach are absent. knowledge is optional with either verdict. The document is a step's result, not a request, and is not signed.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

verdict.description: understood, when the agent understood the ticket; not_understood, when it did not and asks its questions.

complexity.description: How much work the ticket is, and why.

reason.description: Why the ticket is at that level.

understanding.description: The agent's understanding of the ticket.

scope.description: What the work covers and what it leaves out.

in.description: What the work covers, 1 to 50 entries.

out.description: What the work leaves out, 0 to 50 entries.

approach.description: How the agent would do the work, and the approaches it did not choose.

alternatives.description: The approaches the agent did not choose, 0 to 10.

reason.description: Why it is not the chosen approach.

questions.description: What the agent needs answered before it can say how to do the work, 1 to 20 questions.

knowledge.description: What the agent learned that is worth keeping, each with the pages it came from, 0 to 50 entries.

sources.description: The pages it came from, 1 to 10.

text.description: Text that may span lines: tab, line feed and carriage return are its only control characters, and U+0000 to U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F are refused.

short_text.description: A short text, such as a reason, a summary, a question or a scope entry: 1 to 2000 characters.

source.description: A page a piece of knowledge came from: an absolute https URL, at most 2048 characters, with no control characters.
